relations.subject: Paul Dundas
relations.role: honorary fellow in Sanskrit language and Head of Asian studies
relations.evidence: Paul Dundas (23 May 1952 – 5 April 2023) was a Scottish Indologist, an honorary fellow in Sanskrit language and Head of Asian studies at the University of Edinburgh.

relations.subject: Paul Dundas
relations.evidence: He was a member of the Council of the Pali Text Society.
